newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LEICESTER BEAT MIDDLESBROUGH IN ENGLISH LEAGUE CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEICESTER BEAT MIDDLESBROUGH IN ENGLISH LEAGUE CUP FINAL.

text.p: Leicester beat Middlesbrough 1-0 (score after 90 minutes 0-0) in the English League Cup final replay at Hillsborough on Wednesday.

Leicester - 13-Kasey Keller, 2-Simon Grayson, 3-Mike Whitlow (21-Jamie Lawrence 109), 5-Steve Walsh (captain), 17-Spencer Prior, 15-Pontus Kaamark, 6-Muzzy Izzet, 7-Neil Lennon, 10-Gary Parker, 9-Steve Claridge (12-Mark Robins 117), 11-Emile Heskey

Middlesbrough - 25-Ben Roberts, 2-Neil Cox (12-Alan Moore 105), 5-Nigel Pearson (captain), 18-Gianluca Festa (4-Steve Vickers 76), 7-Vladimir Kinder, 8-Robbie Mustoe, 21-Craig Hignett (9-Mikkel Beck 105), 17-Clayton Blackmore, 6-Emerson, 10-Juninho, 11-Fabrizio Ravanelli.
